codeReview.summary: The documentation updates to docs/API.md are accurate and complete, matching the actual handler implementations. However, the changes were NOT committed - they remain uncommitted in the working directory. The handoff incorrectly claims commitId b470106 which only modified docs/REFERENCE.md.

issues.description: Changes to docs/API.md are NOT committed. Git status shows 'modified: docs/API.md' (unstaged). The handoff claims commitId b470106, but git show b470106 only shows changes to docs/REFERENCE.md. The documentation verification work was done correctly but was not committed.

OCR response documentation is incomplete. The handler (ocr.go:16-17) returns both 'text' and 'confidence' fields, but the documentation only shows 'text'. Minor issue since confidence is optional metadata.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The docs-verifier skill example handoff shows commitId being used, but the skill doesn't explicitly require workers to verify the commit was actually made before reporting success. This may lead to workers reporting uncommitted changes as complete.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff claims commitId b470106 but git status shows docs/API.md is still modified (unstaged). The skill's procedure step 5 only mentions 'Document Known Issues' but doesn't require verifying commits.
